introduction: Missouri WIC offers nutrition support for eligible pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding participants and children younger than five.
description: Missouri WIC offers nutrition support for eligible pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding participants and children younger than five.

sections.who: Residency, income and nutrition screening apply. Fathers, guardians and other caregivers may apply for a child.
sections.get: WIC provides supplemental foods, nutrition education, breastfeeding support and referrals.
sections.docs:
• Identity proof for each applicant.
  • Residency evidence.
  • Income or qualifying-benefit records.
sections.apply:
1. Request contact

    Use the WIC interest form or clinic map, or call 800-835-5465.

  2. Arrange certification

    The local agency schedules the health assessment and nutrition education.

  3. Bring proof

    Follow the clinic’s document checklist.
sections.after: Keep follow-up appointments and learn current shopping rules.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri WIC eligibility and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the interest form final approval?
No. Certification requires a local-agency appointment.
